title: Cash Pickup Payout Networks, Corridors and Currency Options
content:
**Network operations bulletin: Cash Pickup coverage by tier.**

Each Cash Pickup tier pays out through one payout network, and only in the corridors it serves. Two further corridor lists apply to each tier: the corridors where the recipient may be paid in US dollars instead of local currency, and the corridors where a transfer purpose must be stated at booking.

## Payout network

| Cash Pickup tier | Where the recipient collects |
|---|---|
| Cash Pickup Economy | retail agent locations |
| Cash Pickup Express | retail agent locations |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | retail agent locations |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | bank branches |
| Cash Pickup Cardless ATM | cardless ATM withdrawal |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | bank branches |

## Corridors served

- **Cash Pickup Economy, Cash Pickup Express, Cash Pickup Express Plus and Cash Pickup Bank Branch:** MX-MXN, GT-GTQ, SV-USD, HN-HNL, DO-DOP, CO-COP, PH-PHP, VN-VND, BD-BDT, NG-NGN and GH-GHS.
- **Cash Pickup Cardless ATM:** MX-MXN, CO-COP and PH-PHP only.
- **Cash Pickup Large Amount:** MX-MXN, GT-GTQ, DO-DOP, CO-COP, PH-PHP and VN-VND.

## US-dollar payout corridors and purpose-code corridors

| Cash Pickup tier | Corridors where a US-dollar payout may be chosen | Corridors where a transfer purpose must be stated |
|---|---|---|
| Cash Pickup Economy | GT-GTQ, HN-HNL, DO-DOP | BD-BDT, NG-NGN, VN-VND |
| Cash Pickup Express | GT-GTQ, HN-HNL, DO-DOP | BD-BDT, NG-NGN, VN-VND |
| Cash Pickup Express Plus | GT-GTQ, HN-HNL, DO-DOP | BD-BDT, NG-NGN, VN-VND |
| Cash Pickup Bank Branch | GT-GTQ, HN-HNL, DO-DOP | BD-BDT, NG-NGN, VN-VND |
| Cash Pickup Cardless ATM | none | none |
| Cash Pickup Large Amount | GT-GTQ, DO-DOP | MX-MXN, GT-GTQ, DO-DOP, CO-COP, PH-PHP, VN-VND |

## Notes on the lists

- A corridor that is not in a tier's corridors-served list is not paid out on that tier. Cash Pickup Cardless ATM, for example, does not serve GT-GTQ.
- On Cash Pickup Cardless ATM no corridor offers a US-dollar payout and no corridor needs a stated purpose.
- On Cash Pickup Large Amount a stated purpose is needed in every corridor the tier serves. HN-HNL is not among them, so it has no US-dollar payout option on that tier.
